paragraphs.html: The policies I assess in this report, represent my judgement of the full list of publicly-announced policies made by the parliamentary leader in the lead-up to the 2022 general election – from release of the 2022–23 Victorian Budget on 3 May 2022 up to 5 pm on 25 November 2022. paragraphs.html: When costing this policy, I formed a necessary judgement about the nature of the fund due to limited public information and a public sector response to my information request advising of commercial sensitivity. On 19 January 2023, the Treasurer Mr. Tim Pallas MP advised me by letter that my judgement was inconsistent with the fund’s actual nature.

paragraphs.html: We assessed how the Liberals and Nationals’ election platform would impact the latest Victorian budget update – the 2022 Victorian Pre-election Budget Update, released on 10 November 2022. We estimate budget impact for the period corresponding with the 2022 Victorian Pre-election Budget Update (to 2025–26) and over the next parliament (to 2026–27) where possible – budget aggregates, like net debt, only exist to 2025–26.

paragraphs.html: The change in net position indicates the overall impact of these election policies on the Victorian budget. It is similar to a change in net debt and measures the gap between the government’s operating revenue and expenses, and movements in assets. A positive change indicates that these election policies would improve the net position of the budget.
